title: Spirit of Buffalo

services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: Sip refreshing cocktails while enjoying a cruise on Lake Erie and the Buffalo River aboard our spacious double-decker Harbor Queen. Join us in paradise aboard the Harbor Queen on this two-hour journey. Celebrate the colorful Caribbean culture with live music from the islands. A cash bar is available. Live music aboard the Harbor Queen! Check our schedule for unique evenings of two-hour entertaining cruises with great music and drinks. Full cash bar and restrooms available. Relax and enjoy the night lights of Buffalo on our gorgeous sailing vessel. Grab a glass of wine or refreshing cool drink and sit back with your loved ones for an evening to cherish. Families are welcome on this evening

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Private charters are the perfect way to celebrate birthdays, retirements, family reunions, and school reunions. Enjoy the most distinctive wedding ceremony, reception, rehearsal dinner and bachelor or bachelorette party. Church groups, tour groups, and company outings will all be extra memorable. Whether your party is large or small, Buffalo Boat Tours has a vessel for every event! Delight your guests with an upscale sailing experience aboard the City’s Flagship. This elegant sail can include catering options on your private charter. The Spirit of Buffalo can host up to 42 guests and has a full bar and bathroom below deck.
